front.text: Battlegrounds lie north (+z); the home coast/ocean is south (-z).

level_rule: Zone field (simple_map.lua zone_level_at): the range split in thirds, rising along z toward the front (or toward the zone middle for front zones); the start bands (L1 <= 100, L2 <= 150 nodes) override near start anchors.
name: Ashenward March

protected.roads: road corridor = half width + 1 node beside the edge after Ruling 1 (today +3), +-5 vertical

quests.description: Every third ration crate vanishes between the storehouse and the line, and my cooks are running out of ways to call hot water supper. Defeat five Entrenched Bandits at the Ashenward Ration Camp east from here, where our missing meals have found an appreciative audience. Someone is keeping those thieves very well supplied.
quests.title: Three Crates Out, Two Crates In

quests.description: At night, Rootbound Ashen Treants roam the Ashenward Cinderwood, which lies in the south of Ashenward March, and they've been knocking my water carts to pieces. Fell five and bring me two lumps of Bitter Resin from them for the barrel repairs. If the woods insist on joining this war, they can contribute to the supply bill.
quests.title: The Trees Can Pay for That

quests.description: Every night, March Skeleton Raiders haunt the ration road through the Ashenward Ashfields, which lie in the southwest of Ashenward March, despite having no use for supper. Break six of them after dark and give my drivers a chance to deliver it. This bounty is repeatable, twenty minutes after you turn it in.
quests.title: Bounty: No Rations for the Dead (repeatable)

quests.description: Our own supply seal is on those stolen crates: Quartermaster Scrip has been selling the line's supper out from under it. Find the quartermaster at the Ashenward Ration Camp east from here and defeat them. There are soldiers scraping empty bowls while that ledger balances beautifully.
quests.title: The Account of Quartermaster Scrip

quests.description: Faeris Rootbinder at Glassroot Gate in Glassroot Wilds keeps sending water, even when all I send back is an apology. Tell her the barrels are coming again, and ask where she needs help. I've work to send you to in Stormvault Heights as well; the forest and the mountain are keeping this same army on its feet.
quests.title: An Answer for Faeris

quests.description: Take word to Borin Splitbolt at Splitbolt Station in Stormvault Heights: the March road is clear and his supplies can move again. Ask what needs doing while you're there; Borin won't send a useful pair of hands home idle. Between his passes and Faeris's woods in Glassroot Wilds, there's work enough for both journeys.
quests.title: Bread for the Mountain Watch

quests.description: The Bramble Bears in the Ashenward Hedgewood, which lies in the heart of Ashenward March, have learned to follow our wagons by daylight. They're after the honey, but the drivers get the claws. Kill four of the bears; I can replace a jar, and I'm tired of writing letters about people I can't.
quests.title: Honey Is Not Worth a Driver

quests.description: Nella Hedgeward at Last Hedge Redoubt keeps the last post before the front standing by sheer refusal to leave it. Report to her when you're ready for the harder fighting. Her last request was for timber, food and people who could think on their feet; I can at least send her you.
quests.title: One More Pair of Hands

quests.description: With the bears thinned, Briar-Web Spiders take the Ashenward Hedgewood at night and string our wagon road shut, horses and all. Kill four of them after dark. Cut the drivers loose first if you find any; the spiders will wait, they always do.
quests.title: Webs Across the Wagon Road

quests.description: Entrenched Bandit Archers at Coalbrand Yard west from here have taken to using our dispatch runners for target practice. Defeat five of them and give the runners room to breathe. Approach carefully; courage has its uses, but it doesn't stop an arrow.
quests.title: A Uniform Is Not a Target

quests.description: Wartrail Poachers at the Ashenward Poacher Camp west from here take the March's game, then charge our cooks whatever desperation will bear. Defeat five of them and break their hold on the hunting grounds. Their marshal signs every sale, as though neat handwriting could make this honest.
quests.title: The Price of an Empty Pot

quests.description: After dark, Trench Shamblers cross the Ashenward Warfields, which lie in the northeast of Ashenward March, and every returning patrol has to fight through them. Put down eight at night so I can count my soldiers through the gate instead of wondering. This bounty becomes available again twenty-five minutes after you turn it in.
quests.title: Bounty: Let the Watch Come Home (repeatable)

quests.description: Poacher Marshal Red-Receipt still runs the trade from the Ashenward Poacher Camp west from here, signing away our soldiers' supper in red ink. Gather a group and kill the marshal; a fighter that dangerous is no job for one exhausted hero. I want all of you back to share the meal when this is done.
quests.title: Group: The Last Receipt

quests.description: The officers can argue over banners once our drivers get the bread through. Kill five Mire-Cured Husks by day in the Causeway Floodmeadows, which lie in the southeast of The Broken Causeway; they keep dragging themselves out of the mud into the carts' path. I'd like to count returning drivers tonight, for a change.
quests.title: Bread Before Banners

quests.description: Daylight gets the husks moving; night brings out the Tollroad Skeletons in the Causeway Floodmeadows. Kill five of those skeletons after dark, before our dawn carts set out. Nobody should have to pay a toll to a man who's outlived his pockets.
quests.title: The Night Shift Never Left

quests.description: Warpack Hyenas have learned that a tired patrol makes easier hunting than a fresh one. Bring down five by day on the Shattered Line Approaches, which lie in the southwest of The Shattered Line. I promised those sentries they'd get home, and I intend to keep it.
quests.title: Nobody's Laughing Here

quests.description: Causeway Brigands have set up in the Causeway Alderwood, which lies in the south of The Broken Causeway, and charge our drivers for the privilege of being robbed. Defeat five of them by day. The only toll on that road should be the mud.
quests.title: Toll Collectors in the Alderwood

quests.description: The fletchers have requested three Siege Cat Claws, very neatly written and without a single offer to fetch them. Hunt Tallgrass Tigers by day on the Shattered Line Bluffs, which lie in the northeast of The Shattered Line, and bring the claws to me. I'll see that your name goes on the delivery.
quests.title: The Fletchers' Bright Idea

quests.description: My father called that war finished, but the Causeway Battlefield, which lies in the south of The Broken Causeway, seems to have missed the announcement. Go by day and put down five of the Mire-Cured Husks and Causeway Brigands picking over it. We still need a way through the ground they died fighting over.
quests.title: What the War Left Standing

quests.description: Speak with Alna Archsight at Archshadow Post in Stormvault Heights and give her our report: Cinderline Watch still stands. She needs to hear what you've seen on The Broken Causeway before she sends more people into it. If she asks whether we're cheerful, tell her we're fed; she'll understand.
quests.title: Cinderline Still Stands

quests.description: My sentries will face an army, but they've asked for somewhere to put their feet. Kill five War-Stinger Scorpions after dark on the Shattered Line Ramparts, which lie in the northeast of The Shattered Line. Seems a fair request from people who spend all night standing up for us.
quests.title: A Sentry Needs Somewhere to Stand

quests.description: Both armies dug the Shattered Line Trenches, which lie in the west of The Shattered Line, and Siege Skeleton Raiders now man them every night. Break five of them after dark. I would like to hear what our scouts saw out there without first hearing what chased them home.
quests.title: Raiders in the Trenches

quests.description: Every night, Siege Skeleton Raiders gather beneath the banner of Standard-Bearer Ninepins at the Shattered Line Breach northeast from here. Kill five of those raiders after dark and defeat their standard-bearer. Let the next thing our watch hears from that breach be the wind.
quests.title: Nobody Left to Rally

quests.description: The Tallgrass Tigers have picked the Shattered Line Siegecrest, which lies in the northeast of The Shattered Line, for themselves, and I need it for a lookout. Bring down five there by day for a bounty. You can take the job again twenty-five minutes after each turn-in; apparently my sentries and the cats share a taste in views.
quests.title: Bounty: Room for a Lookout (repeatable)

quests.description: I can hear War Construct Engine Nine grinding along the Shattered Line Siegecrest northeast from here, even when I close my eyes. Gather a group and destroy that elite war construct. Before you go, learn each other's names; I want everyone answering to them when you get back.
quests.title: Group: An End to the Grinding

quests.description: Borin Splitbolt needs fighters for Gravesalt Escarpment, and I can think of one who's earned the recommendation. Speak with him at Splitbolt Station in Stormvault Heights and tell him what happened on The Shattered Line. Leave the mud on your boots; Borin trusts that more than a seal.
quests.title: A Recommendation with Mud on It
